answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 75 identities per epoch. Audits are recorded in harbor, queued in forge, and crystal publishes the wait time. A farm of 240 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 4625 identities would post 916 proofs and burn roughly 43 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
